page.overview:
What is Brick Sketches?

Brick Sketches is a theme that was released on June 15, 2020.

The sets are designed by Chris McVeigh, who before being hired by LEGO posted many of Brick Sketches to Flickr. The theme was revealed on May 21, 2020 by Brickset with a release date set for June 15.
